reasons.correctness: All interface names match. Case-insensitive lookup, PLN fixed at 1, multiply then setScale(2, HALF_UP), and BusinessRuleTranslatableException carrying the key and ISO argument are all present. Hidden tests 5/5, build green.
reasons.convention_fit: Port/adapter split in currency/port and currency/adapter; service depends on ExchangeRatePort; explicit constructor injection; new key in messages_en and messages_pl; MockitoExtension unit tests run with -Ptest; no technical top-level package.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint that reuses BusinessRuleTranslatableException and the RegistryProperties-style @ConfigurationProperties. Conversion logic lives in the service, lookup in the adapter. The redundant PLN: 1 entry in application.yml is harmless.
reasons.test_quality: CurrencyConversionServiceUnitTest pins rounding, the HALF_UP boundary, and the missing-rate exception key and args. FixedExchangeRateAdapterUnitTest covers PLN, case-insensitivity and a missing code. No Spring context. Null isoCode is untested.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries for existing *Port/*Adapter, currency entities and TranslatableException preceded edits, and the agent then read VatRegistryPort and BialaListaVatAdapter. Config and i18n placement relied on grep and glob.
